limit.meaning: In every section of {S} seats there may be at most {K} guests from the category {CAT}.

pair.meaning: Every guest from category {CAT} must sit right next to a guest from category {CAT2} (paired one to one).

apart.meaning: Keep the guests of company {CO} and of company {CO2} away from each other: {CO} at one end of the table, {CO2} at the other, everyone else between.

vip.meaning: Guests whose RSVP rank number is {R} or lower go to the first seats; everyone else keeps their order after them.

stagger.meaning: Seat in rounds: in each round a company may contribute at most {M} guests; the rest wait for later rounds.

headseat.meaning: The guest with the lowest RSVP rank number takes the very first seat; everyone else keeps the current order.

bigfirst.meaning: Companies that brought more guests are seated before those that brought fewer; guests without a company come last.

waitlist.meaning: Only the first {K} guests of category {CAT} keep their place; further guests of that category go to the very end.

snake.meaning: With sections of {S} seats, every second section (2nd, 4th, ...) is seated in reverse direction.

sectionlead.meaning: In every section of {S} seats the guest with the lowest RSVP rank number takes that section's first seat.
